digest.component_or_area: Pandoc corpus verification and external replay
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently runs complete live-Pandoc corpus replay on every change, contributing measurable overhead (184.32s lower bound on macOS).
The implementation must replace per-change live corpus replay with committed deterministic artifacts while retaining all behavioral assertions and one representative live body per stratum.
External Integration Tests must run full real-Pandoc replay of all 1,383 corpus conversions on a weekly schedule and via workflow_dispatch.
Static converter must fail closed on platform/version mismatches before trusting committed fixture outputs.
Paired A/B measurement shows 90.8% wall-time reduction in focused phase (42s to 4s) when broad assertions consume committed outputs instead of subprocess replay.
